subject: website
name: Kleros Scout
summary: Kleros Scout, the curated registry of address tags and token entries. Its source is public (no licence file) in the Kleros Scout repository and a copy kept for IPFS hosting. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it reads Gnosis Chain through a public RPC, needs an indexer and Kleros's CDN to show its lists, and loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: Gnosis RPC (rpc.gnosischain.com)
connections.note: Read without a light client when the page opens.

connections.name: HyperIndex indexer (indexer.hyperindex.xyz)
connections.note: Queried when the page opens to list entries.

connections.name: Kleros CDN (cdn.kleros.link)
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens for entry data.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
